defects.description: Grammatical error: the list is inconsistent. 'корневых' is used as an adjective without a noun, and 'домен верхнего уровня' is in the nominative case while the rest of the list is in the genitive.
defects.quote: авторитетных корневых, домен верхнего уровня (TLD) и других серверов имён

defects.description: Incorrect translation of the technical term 'Origin' in the context of DNS zone files; 'Начало' (beginning) does not accurately convey the meaning of the base domain of a zone.
Literal translation of the English impersonal 'One wants', which is unnatural in Russian technical style.
Grammatical error: the glossary term 'Обратная запись DNS' is not inflected to fit the sentence structure, resulting in a redundant and incorrect phrase ('записей [Обратная запись DNS]').
Grammatical error: the participle 'называемый' requires the instrumental case ('подчиненным сервером'), but the nominative was used.
